heroHeadline: Malaysia Lifts Sarawak Haze Emergency as Panama Canal Eyes 5-Year Fix for Drought Cuts
heroSubtitle: Malaysia's King lifted Serian's state of emergency on Sept. 7 even as its API climbed back to 245 and 11 Sarawak areas stayed unhealthy, while Panama Canal Administrator Ilya Espino de Marotta said the Rio Indio project would end future draft and transit cuts — but not for another 5-6 years, leaving near-term restrictions on the table.
